note: Retell: OK, so, the Model T. I started thinking it was the assembly line that made it cheap. But really the order is: Ford decides the price first, a car a family can afford. Then one model, so you can build one line. Then the line, which makes the work so boring that everyone quits, so then the five dollars to keep them. Everything follows from the price. And for us, honestly, we did it the other way round with our pricing, we added up costs, and ended up at a price nobody wants.
